 Starshine Garden Perfectly Bloomed Hydrangeas Set

Starshine Garden Hopper (Korean: 별빛정원을 뛰노는, byeolbitjeong-won-eul ttwinoneun) is Floral Froglet's second Costume, released in the first half of the Yakgwa Village: Haunting Tales update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained by purchasing it in the GCL Limited Costume Shop!.

Story

Don't be surprised if you see something green whiz past you in the Starshine Garden! It's just Floral Froglet hopping around. Maybe the ambitious Pet wanted more than star-shaped flowers. Could this adorable critter make its leap for the stars in the night sky?

Trivia

  • Starshine Garden Hopper was released alongside  Lighthearted Poet,  Misty Trail Hermit,  Starshine Garden,  Moonlit Nightwalk Guide,  Strange Reappearance, and  Glistening Thread.
  • Starshine Garden Hopper is the first Pet Costume to only be obtainable from the GCL Limited Costume Shop!.
    • This also makes it the first Pet Costume released for the Grand Champions League.

Flowered UP! (Korean: 꽃단장님, kkotdanjangnim) is Floral Froglet's first Costume, released in the first half of The Dragon's Garden Paradise update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Cookies from the Lotus Palace are going on a picnic!
"If you behave yourself, you can come too, Floral Froglet!"
Oh boy, oh boy indeed! Look at how this Pet has dressed up for this excursion!

Trivia

  • Flowered UP! was released alongside  Golden Warrior,  Red Equinox,  Sage of Ivies, and  Witherbark Shaman.
  • Flowered UP! is the first Pet Costume to be owned by an Epic Pet.
    • It is also the first Pet Costume to be in the Epic rarity.
